name: yue-token-cost benchmark testset v0
note: Each item is the same meaning expressed in four scripts. Content domain: Hong Kong labour/legal enquiries - the same domain as the author's existing projects. Sentences are hand-written, not machine-translated, so that script differences reflect real writing rather than translation artefacts.

items.label: Paid annual leave entitlement
items.en: How many days of paid annual leave am I entitled to?

items.label: Wage arrears - employer unpaid for three months
items.en: My employer has not paid my salary for three months. What can I do?
items.zh_s: 雇主已经三个月没有支付我的工资，我可以怎么办？
items.zh_t: 僱主已經三個月沒有支付我的工資，我可以怎麼辦？
items.yue: 老細已經三個月冇出糧，我可以點做？

items.label: Notice period before termination
items.en: How much notice must my employer give before terminating my contract?
items.zh_s: 雇主终止合约前必须提前多久通知我？
items.zh_t: 僱主終止合約前必須提前多久通知我？
items.yue: 老細炒我之前要提早幾久通知我？

items.label: Doctor's note for sick leave
items.en: Do I need a doctor's note to take sick leave?
items.zh_s: 请病假需要医生证明吗？
items.zh_t: 請病假需要醫生證明嗎？

items.label: Statutory holiday pay included in monthly salary
items.en: Is statutory holiday pay included in my monthly salary?
items.zh_s: 法定假期薪酬是否已包含在月薪中？
items.zh_t: 法定假期薪酬是否已包含在月薪中？
items.yue: 法定假期嘅錢係咪已經包喺月薪入面？

items.label: Employment Ordinance wage-payment clause (formal register)
items.en: Under the Employment Ordinance, an employer must pay wages within seven days after the end of the wage period.
items.zh_s: 根据《雇佣条例》，雇主必须在工资期届满后七天内支付工资。
items.zh_t: 根據《僱傭條例》，僱主必須在工資期屆滿後七天內支付工資。
items.yue: 根據《僱傭條例》，老細必須喺工資期完結之後七日內出糧。
